title: Knowledge Database Coordinator — System Overview
description: The coordinator searches the live JAH Databases manifest — 58,222 databases — by keyword and returns matches with page URLs.

title: Manifest Integrity — The Count Must Match
t: Manifest Integrity — The Count Must Match
description: database_count is cross-checked against actual entries on every load; a mismatch is reported, never hidden.

title: Keyword Search — "calculator"
description: A single keyword returns ranked matches: slug, name, record kind, and page URL.

title: Keyword Search — "signature spec"
description: Multi-term queries combine scores so databases matching both terms rank highest.

title: Exact Lookup — One Slug, One Database
t: Exact Lookup — One Slug, One Database
description: lookup() resolves a slug to its full manifest entry plus its network page URL.

title: Lookup Miss — Unknown Slugs Fail Honestly
t: Lookup Miss — Unknown Slugs Fail Honestly
description: A slug that does not exist returns an explicit not-found error, not an empty guess.

title: Multi-Keyword Search — "quantum simulator"
description: Technical phrases match across the manifest's real vocabulary, with match counts reported.

title: Page URL Wiring — Every Match Links to Its Database Page
t: Page URL Wiring — Every Match Links to Its Database Page
description: Results carry absolute page URLs built from the slug under the live databases site.

title: Load Performance — 58,222 Entries in About a Second
t: Load Performance — 58,222 Entries in About a Second
description: The full manifest parses in roughly one second on the build host; search itself is milliseconds.

title: Empty Query Handling — Refused, Not Crashed
t: Empty Query Handling — Refused, Not Crashed
description: An empty query returns an explicit error instead of dumping the whole manifest.

title: Interfaces — Search, Lookup, Stats, Integrity
description: The module exports loadManifest, search, lookup, and stats; the CLI mirrors them.

title: Usage Guide — From Question to Matches
t: Usage Guide — From Question to Matches
description: Load the manifest once, search as often as needed, hand the matches to the master.

title: Limits and Honest Boundaries
description: The coordinator reads the manifest; it does not fetch live pages, verify record contents, or reach the network.

title: Integration — Feeding the Master Coordinator
description: Stage 1 of the master pipeline is this exact call: keywords in, ranked databases out.

title: Scoring Algorithm — How Matches Are Ranked
t: Scoring Algorithm — How Matches Are Ranked
description: Slug matches weigh 5, name 3, tagline 2, full text 1 — deterministic and explainable.
